info.title: Multiple Linear Regression Service
info.description: A service that implements a Multiple Linear Regression model using a dataset represented as a JSON object compatible with a Pandas DataFrame.

post.description: Perform Multiple Linear Regression using the input dataset provided in JSON format.

dataframe.description: Dataset represented as a dictionary where keys are column names and values are arrays of column data.

independent_variables.description: List of column names to be used as independent variables.

dependent_variable.description: Column name to be used as the dependent variable.

model_summary.description: Summary statistics of the regression model.

coefficients.description: Mapping of independent variables to their estimated coefficients.

400.description: Invalid input. Check the request payload format.

500.description: Internal server error while processing regression.
